attributes.title: Reorder
attributes.lede: Pull a track out of line.

lesson.concept: Order is application state, motion explains its change
lesson.why: The group updates the values array while each track keeps stable identity. A lifted row remains recognizable as neighbours make room around it.
lesson.experiment: Move the same track upward and then downward without releasing. Change the pickup preset and distinguish the active row from displaced neighbours.
lesson.pitfall: Updating only DOM order or using array positions as identities separates the visual order from the application's data.
lesson.combine: Combine with a handle-driven drag when rows contain inputs or selection controls.
